_comment: 忆海 Mnemosyne - English. 键名规范对标 ISS：school.<ns>.<path> / attribute.<ns>.<name> / spell.<ns>.<id>[.guide] / subtitles.<ns>.*
_comment_engram: 忆格（WS-B 追加）。engram.mnemosyne.spell 有两个参数：法术名 + 等级。
_comment_hud: NOTE 2026-09-17: the engram HUD was removed; engram state is now reported via action bar messages.
_comment_msg_wsd: WS-D spell action-bar feedback. Argument order follows each spell's Component.translatable call.
_comment_wsf: Scrolls & spell books (added by WS-F). Scrolls reuse the official irons_spellbooks:scroll item, so there is deliberately no item.mnemosyne.memory_scroll key.
_comment_wsj: Blocks & stele interaction (added by WS-J). There is deliberately no key for the crystal block / lamp - they have no textures and are not registered (see ModBlocks).
_comment_wsj_entity: WS-J entity (Memory Wraith). The spawn egg item name is required too, otherwise the inventory shows the raw id.
_comment_wsj_items: WS-J items (memory rune / stele fragment / mnemonic robe).
_comment_wsk_gear: WS-K gear: docs/07 section 3 (weapons) and section 4 (materials).
mnemosyne.feedback.engrams_lost: You died — all engrams are lost
mnemosyne.feedback.no_overload: Target has no Cognitive Overload to detonate
mnemosyne.msg.deja_vu_empty: You have not cast any spell in that window.
mnemosyne.msg.encode_no_essence: This creature has no essence worth recording.
mnemosyne.msg.engrave_end_kept: Engraving should fade, but the borrowed slots still hold spells — empty them first.
mnemosyne.msg.engrave_no_slot: No free engram — nothing to engrave into.
mnemosyne.msg.engrave_ok: Engraved: spell limit +%d, +1 temporary engram (%d s).
mnemosyne.msg.memory_overload: Your memory is full (%s/%s). Release a memory before inscribing.
mnemosyne.msg.pain_no_hit: Pain window closed — you were not hit
mnemosyne.msg.pain_reflected: Pain Memory: the pain you took has been returned
mnemosyne.msg.recollection_triggered: Recollection triggered — you survived, but your memory is blank
mnemosyne.msg.recollection_ward: Afterglow lit (one death prevented within the window)
mnemosyne.msg.stele_all_learned: There is no spell left in this stele that you have not remembered.
mnemosyne.msg.stele_exhausted: You have already read this memory.
mnemosyne.msg.stele_first_hint: At an inscription table, you can copy remembered spells with a memory crystal.
mnemosyne.msg.temp_slot_collapsed: A temporary engram expired; %d memor(ies) within faded with it.
mnemosyne.msg.theft_boss: The memory of such a being cannot be taken.
mnemosyne.msg.theft_failed: Plunder failed: your engrams are full.
mnemosyne.msg.theft_generic: The target had no trait to plunder; a generic memory was inscribed.
mnemosyne.msg.theft_no_effect: The target has no beneficial effects to steal.
mnemosyne.msg.thousand_no_target: No valid target to settle with.
mnemosyne.msg.thousand_ok: Thousand Memories: burned %s memories for %s damage.
spell.mnemosyne.amnesia.guide: Strip a creature of every special ability and leave it dazed. It keeps breathing, but it forgets how to fight.
spell.mnemosyne.cognitive_collapse.guide: Overload a creature's mind until it can no longer tell memory from reality.
spell.mnemosyne.curse_of_oblivion.guide: Leave a lingering field that keeps erasing the memory of everything inside it.
spell.mnemosyne.deja_vu.guide: Rewind a single moment, so that the last thing that happened happens again.
spell.mnemosyne.encode_pain.guide: Open a pain window. Attacks you take are immediately returned to the attacker.
spell.mnemosyne.encode_trait.guide: Write a creature's essence into an engram slot and borrow one of its traits for a while.
spell.mnemosyne.engrave.guide: Long chant. Engrave capacity into your own memory: briefly raises your spell limit and grants a temporary engram.
spell.mnemosyne.endless_realm.guide: Open a sealed domain and flood everything inside with endless recollection — nothing within it can move, yet it deals no damage.
spell.mnemosyne.expand_mind.guide: Temporarily open two additional engram slots.
spell.mnemosyne.glimpse.guide: Read a creature's memory to reveal what it is, what it carries, and what it can do.
spell.mnemosyne.mass_amnesia.guide: Erase the memory of every creature around you at once.
spell.mnemosyne.retrograde.guide: Read the traces left in an area over the last few dozen seconds, replay them, and track down whoever struck last.
spell.mnemosyne.oblation.guide: Burn a memory for a brief window where casting costs nothing — at the price of your own cognition overloading.
spell.mnemosyne.adaptation.guide: Inscribe the hits you take, then turn them into resistance against that damage type. Dodge too well and you learn nothing.
spell.mnemosyne.framebind.guide: Force enemies in range to move at 24 frames. Move faster and they are pinned for a second — but hitting them frees them early.
mnemosyne.adaptation.broad: Adapted: every inscribed type reduced by %1$s
mnemosyne.oblation.window: Free-cast window: %1$ss — do not write engrams yet
spell.mnemosyne.memory_arrow.guide: Fires a shard of crystallized memory. Cheap, fast, and it is how a Mnemosyne caster opens every fight.
spell.mnemosyne.memory_shard.guide: Hurl a burst of shattered memories that wounds and briefly disorients.
spell.mnemosyne.memory_theft.guide: Long chant. Tear beneficial effects off the target and take them for yourself.
spell.mnemosyne.recollection.guide: Light an Afterglow: a 6-14s death-prevention window that scales with spell level. The first fatal blow inside it is prevented, at the cost of a period of memory blankness.
spell.mnemosyne.sea_of_memory.guide: Flood an area with raw memory and drown everything inside it in recollection.
spell.mnemosyne.thousand_memories.guide: Burn every engram you hold to release one final, total recall.
